acceptance_predicates.description: Only an AR-1776 repository and exact immutable revision can be selected; moving refs, unrelated repositories, and arbitrary paths are rejected.
The provider returns a project-local checkout whose repository identity and HEAD exactly match the catalog before AR-1778 consumes it.
Checkout transfer, staging, argv/env, hooks, time, output, path, and cleanup are bounded and credential-free.
Offline, unavailable, identity, revision, limit, cancellation, and cleanup failures remain distinct actionable outcomes.
AR-1779 invokes the AR-1778 pinned source builder with the verified checkout and records the real source-build result.

definition_of_done: Source-only supported tool installation succeeds through a verified checkout and pinned builder in deterministic fixtures.
Independent review, exact-head CI, signed protected merge, and exact-main post-merge evidence pass.

inputs.description: AR-1778 pinned source builder and dependency materializer.

outputs.description: Bounded verified source checkout provider integrated into supported tool installation.

gates.description: Positive and negative deterministic checkout-provider matrix passes.
AR-1779 source-only installation invokes the verified checkout and AR-1778 builder, with exact receipt evidence.
